forecasts.reference-class: Elderly heads of state whose tenure could end by death or removal within a near-term horizon; specifically, an 86-year-old male Supreme Leader. Base-rate anchor draws on age-specific mortality (e.g., death probability for a male aged 86–87 is about 12% per year in standard life-tables).
